ICC Chief Hails India’s Dominant Asian Games Cricket Victory

ICC chairman Jay Shah and BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia have extended their congratulations to the Indian women’s cricket team following their successful defense of the Asian Games gold medal. This performance demonstrated the depth and skill of the Indian squad as they asserted their dominance in the tournament. Shah and Saikia’s presence at the venue underscored the high level of institutional support for the women’s team’s achievements.
